text:
deploybot: preflight FAILED for release/2026-03-21T10:00Z. Issue: secret encoding and keystore prefix parity mismatch between staging and prod. See diff below.

deploybot: diff:
 - staging.secrets.backend = "sops"
 - prod.secrets.backend = "kms+base64"
 - staging.keystore_prefix = "/keystore/v2/"
 - prod.keystore_prefix = "/keystore/v2"
 - affected service: inference-router (config resolver)

grace: ugh, that explains the resolver 502s we saw in canary this morning. The router strips trailing slashes and expects decoded secret blobs.

amir: how did prod end up with base64-wrapped secrets? I thought sops -> plaintext during deploy was standardized.

infra-bot: note: infra PR 1105 changed sops -> s3 upload behavior to optionally preserve encoding. Prod overlay still on old behavior.

release-eng: summary: infra change landed, but prod helm overlay didn't include the new secret_backend flag. Staging got the new infra because the deploy pipeline picks latest infra for ephemeral envs.

grace: options: rollback image, patch config to accept both encodings, or patch prod overlay + run secret conversion job. Window is 40m.

amir: quick risk eval:
 - rollback image: low-risk for app-level regressions, but doesn't fix encoded secret mismatch if secret format is assumed by runtime codepaths introduced in latest image.
 - patch runtime to accept both: medium-risk, code change required and needs testing.
 - backfill/convert prod secrets to match staging: medium risk (migration script), but reversible if we keep backups. Takes ~15-25m.

ops-bot: recommended: HOLD promotion. Run secret conversion script in prod bucket first against small prefix for verification. If conversion succeeds, promote. Otherwise rollback image.

grace: I'm +1 on conversion first. We'll keep a restore snapshot. Amir, can you run the conversion and validate with the resolver?

amir: on it. Starting test run on prod-test prefix. Command I'll use:

```
python infra/tools/secret_convert.py --src backend=kms+base64 --dst backend=sops --bucket redwood-prod-secrets --prefix keystore/v2/test --dry-run
```

infra-bot: reminder: creds for conversion must use role: infra/secrets-migrator.

grace: also capture checksum and last-modified for all converted objects. We want a quick diff to ensure nothing mutates unexpectedly.

amIR: dry-run looks good. Conversion script reports 0 incompatible entries in test prefix. Going to run full conversion on keystore/v2. Estimated 12m.

release-eng: fine, but open a rollback PR in parallel so we can revert quickly if needed. Also add a release note hold marker.

grace: creating rollback PR to pin inference-router image to release-2026-03-19-bb2c. I'll include release note: "Hold: prod secret encoding mismatch; running conversion."

deploybot: promotion paused by user.

amir: starting conversion run. Monitoring logs.

amir: conversion completed. 213 objects converted. Sample validation: decode(base64) -> parsed JSON for secret blob. No errors.

grace: triggering a canary re-deploy of the new image against a normalized config in prod canary.

deploybot: canary deploy started for inference-router (tag: release-2026-03-21-ccc333). Canary running on 5% of traffic.

ops-bot: watch metrics: router_error_rate, secret_lookup_latency. Alert if error_rate > 0.5% for 5m.

amir: canary logs show successful secret resolves and no 5xx. Latency unchanged.

grace: rolling forward plan: if canary is green at 15m, promote. Otherwise, rollback to previous image. Change window ends in 28m.

release-eng: update infra overlay PR to include explicit secret_backend flag and trailing-slash normalization in prod helm overlay: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1120 (draft).

grace: can we also add automated normalization check in release-check to catch trailing slash differences?

release-eng: yes, adding a rule to normalize and compare trimmed paths and encoding metadata. I'll include that in the next release-check patch.

deploybot: canary metrics stable at 10m mark. No errors.

amir: starting full promotion now.

deploybot: promotion started: inference-router promoted to release-2026-03-21-ccc333 across regions.

grace: monitoring: no regression. Support informed to watch for user reports. Adding short note to release notes and postmortem placeholder for infra team.

ops-bot: change window notice: promotion completed within window.

release-eng: follow-ups:
 - infra PR 1120 to finalize overlay normalization and merge to prod overlays
 - add release-check normalization rule (ticket INF-2301)
 - runbook entry: secret conversion steps and rollback procedure (wiki link created)

grace: thanks all. Closing thread once infra PR merged.

infra-bot: auto-link: infra PR 1120 created by release-eng.

deploybot: release-check PASS post-promotion.

amir: leaving logs and conversion artifact on s3://infra-migrations/keystore-v2/2026-03-21/ for audit.
